refnamediv.refpurpose: Return all objects including their respective object ID within the specified one

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
hostname
The hostname of the SNMP agent (server), optionally followed by a port, as in 127.0.0.1:161.
community
The read community.
object_id
The root of the subtree to read: all the SNMP objects below object_id are returned. An empty string stands for .1.3.6.1.2.1 (mib-2), which is only a part of the whole tree. &null; does the same, but is deprecated.
An array with a single element is accepted. An array with several elements is not, as a walk reads a single subtree: an E_WARNING is emitted and &false; is returned.
timeout
The number of microseconds until the first timeout. The default, -1, selects the Net-SNMP library default: the timeout and retries settings of snmp.conf if present, otherwise one second and 5 retries.
retries
The number of times to retry if timeouts occur. The default, -1, selects the Net-SNMP library default, see timeout.

&reftitle.examples;
Using snmp2_real_walk
<?php print_r(snmp2_real_walk("localhost", "public", "IF-MIB::ifName")); ?>
The above will output something like:
Array ( [IF-MIB::ifName.1] => STRING: "lo" [IF-MIB::ifName.2] => STRING: "eth0" [IF-MIB::ifName.3] => STRING: "eth2" [IF-MIB::ifName.4] => STRING: "sit0" [IF-MIB::ifName.5] => STRING: "sixxs" )
